content.value_statement: AI teams need reliable ways to manage context, memory, and retrieval across complex workflows. This skill guides architecture choices for RAG, vector search, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent handoffs.
actual_capabilities: Designs context architectures for AI systems and multi-agent workflows.
Recommends vector database, embedding, and hybrid search strategies.
Defines memory models for conversations, facts, and working context.
Plans RAG ingestion, chunking, retrieval, synthesis, and freshness controls.
Creates governance guidance for enterprise context isolation and audit trails.
Suggests metrics for context quality, latency, cost, and relevance.
limitations: Provides guidance only; it does not deploy databases, APIs, or infrastructure.
Requires project details, data sources, and security requirements for precise recommendations.
Does not replace security, privacy, or compliance review for regulated data.
Supplemental implementation resources may vary by installation.

use_cases.title: Plan enterprise RAG architecture
use_cases.description: Create retrieval, storage, chunking, and governance plans for a large document assistant.

use_cases.title: Improve vector search quality
use_cases.description: Review embedding, metadata, hybrid search, and ranking choices for better retrieval results.

use_cases.title: Coordinate multi-agent workflows
use_cases.description: Define context handoff, state tracking, and role-specific memory for connected AI agents.

prompt_templates.title: Map my context needs
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define context requirements for my AI application. Ask for missing goals, users, data sources, privacy limits, and success metrics before recommending an approach.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new AI feature

prompt_templates.title: Design a RAG retrieval plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a RAG plan for a document assistant with these data sources, user roles, freshness needs, and latency targets. Include chunking, metadata, retrieval, and evaluation guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Create a memory architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose a memory architecture for long-running conversations. Separate working memory, episodic memory, semantic memory, retention rules, and privacy controls.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced design for persistent AI assistants

prompt_templates.title: Audit context quality at scale
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this context management design for relevance, isolation, latency, cost, observability, and failure recovery. Recommend prioritized changes and validation tests.

output_examples.input: Design a context system for a customer support agent using product docs and ticket history.
output: Architecture outline for ingestion, indexing, retrieval, and response assembly.
Memory model separating active ticket state from durable customer history.
Evaluation plan for answer quality, latency, freshness, and access control.

output_examples.input: Optimize RAG performance for a large internal knowledge base.
output: Recommendations for chunking, metadata enrichment, hybrid search, and reranking.
Monitoring metrics for retrieval precision, stale content, cost, and latency.
Rollout plan for testing improvements before production release.

output_examples.input: Create context handoff rules for a multi-agent research workflow.
output: Role-specific context bundles for planning, retrieval, synthesis, and review agents.
Handoff rules for state, citations, assumptions, and unresolved questions.
Failure handling guidance for conflicting evidence and missing context.

best_practices: Start with clear task boundaries, data sensitivity, and freshness requirements.
Measure context quality with retrieval precision, answer usefulness, latency, and cost.
Separate short-term conversation state from durable enterprise knowledge.
anti_patterns: Indexing every document without chunking, metadata, or access controls.
Sharing context across tenants or agents without isolation rules.
Expanding context windows instead of improving retrieval and pruning.

faq.question: What does this skill help me design?
faq.answer: It helps design context, retrieval, memory, and handoff systems for AI applications.

faq.question: Can it choose a vector database?
faq.answer: It can compare options and selection criteria, but you must validate choices against your environment.

faq.question: Does it build or deploy infrastructure?
faq.answer: No. It provides architecture and implementation guidance, not automatic deployment.

faq.question: Is it useful for enterprise data?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes governance, isolation, audit trails, and lifecycle planning for enterprise context.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing RAG system?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review retrieval quality, chunking, ranking, freshness, and evaluation methods.
